content.value: Sample of n = 6 items each are taken from a manufacturing process at regular intervals. A quality characteristics is measured and X and R values are calculated for each sample. After 50 sample, the results are $\begin{array} { r } { \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { 5 0 } \overline { { X } } _ { \imath } = 2 0 0 0 } \end{array}$ and $\textstyle \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { 5 0 } R _ { i } = 2 5 0$
(i) Compute control limits for the X and R control chart.
(ii) Calculate natural tolerance Limits of the process.
